Description: "Explicitly bind visibleMin and visibleMax to the last 15 candles when _autoScroll is active to guarantee the auto-zoom behavior works consistently across hot-restarts and stock switching."
Instruction: "Add visibleMin and visibleMax properties to CategoryAxis."
ReplacementContent:
"        primaryXAxis: CategoryAxis(
          name: 'primaryXAxis',
          majorGridLines: const MajorGridLines(width: 0.5, color: Color(0xFF2A2E39)),
          axisLine: const AxisLine(width: 0),
          labelStyle: const TextStyle(color: AppTheme.dimTextColor, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          majorTickLines: const MajorTickLines(size: 0),
          edgeLabelPlacement: EdgeLabelPlacement.shift,
          labelIntersectAction: AxisLabelIntersectAction.hide,
          visibleMin: _autoScroll && candles.length > 15
              ? (candles.length - 15).toDouble()
              : null,
          visibleMax: _autoScroll && candles.length > 15
              ? (candles.length - 1).toDouble()
              : null,
          // SMART AUTO-SCROLL: Keep viewport size stable at maxVisibleCandles to prevent squeezing all historical candles into one screen
          autoScrollingDelta: AppConstants.maxVisibleCandles,
          autoScrollingMode: AutoScrollingMode.end,"
